==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| profession = Mesmer 
| primary = y
| campaign = factions
}}

===Objectives===
* Speak to [[Instructor Ng]].
* Complete the [[Defense Against Hexes]] course. 
* Complete the [[Disenchantment Course|Disenchantment]] course. 
* Complete the [[Disruption]] course. 
* Complete the [[Skill Chaining]] course. 
* See [[Headmaster Kaa]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 2,000 [[Experience]] 
* 75 [[Gold]]
* 1 [[Monastery Credit]]

==Walkthrough==
This quest requires the completion of four sub-quests given also by Instructor Ng. The order of completion is entirely optional.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
'''Headmaster Kaa'''
:''"You are ready to earn your Mesmer Insignia? All right, then. This advanced training is designed to teach you the nuances of using chaos to your advantage. Mesmers must master the art of manipulating and disrupting their enemies: they use Illusion to fool enemies, Domination to trick foes into harming themselves, and Inspiration to empower themselves by stealing Energy from enemies. Speak with '''Instructor Ng''' to begin your training."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I am ready to earn my Mesmer Insignia.
| decline = I am not ready yet.
| ask = It was my understanding that you wished to become an expert Mesmer. Speak with '''Instructor Ng''' to begin training for your Mesmer Insignia.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Headmaster Kaa'''
:''"Congratulations. You have earned your Mesmer Insignia. You are now an expert Mesmer. May Lyssa guide you and Dwayna protect you."''

==Notes==
*Although you don't have to do the Advanced Defense Techniques, it is useful to do so, as you will gain a mesmer skill [[Clumsiness]] upon quest acceptance.
